p1_findings_for_parent_orchestrator.title: Stress command verdict semantics — false-negative on mixed type with no kiosk tokens
p1_findings_for_parent_orchestrator.summary: foodking:e2e:stress --type=mixed counts 401 'kiosk-no-token' responses as 'failed' in its HTTP breakdown, then ships verdict=FAIL even though DB invariants pass. Reviewers reading only the verdict line would miss the actual GREEN state. Consider a future enhancement: distinguish 'expected 4xx' (auth absent) from 'unexpected failures' in the stress report.
